svg.title: A finished volume and three layers of reusable context
svg.desc: An archive-design example reveals exactly three supporting leaves below a finished clothbound ATRL cover. The first holds the educational decay model, initial value and characteristic times; the second holds common-time Python expressions and existing CSV samples at x=0, 1 and 2; the third holds the reason for adding the axis condition and the selected revised manuscript. The physical ribbon connects to an open initial-value question on the right. The small cover curves are motifs read from the same existing CSV.
